author: 0xunclebill
content: We have a [PR](https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/10015/changes) that will blind the payload including the BAL. and we will be calling `engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV2` to reconstruct the full payload (for finalized envelopes).  I feel like BALs should be retained on the EL side for the same number of epochs...

author: nflaig
content: the behavior of ELs is just really bizarre, they have hardcoded constant like `WeakSubjectivityPeriodEpochs = 3533` or  `BAL_RETENTION_EPOCHS = 3533` and claiming it's the weak subjectivity period... if we hard code this, then let's not use a 10 safety decay for it, also the wsp depends on total active eth staked, so either way this is wrong, can we fix this <@&1460290804898861117>

author: nflaig
content:
was this just copy-pasted from https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7928, which states
> The EL MUST retain BALs for at least the duration of the weak subjectivity period (=3533 epochs) to support synchronization with re-execution after being offline for less than the WSP.
cc <@792404665068158998> I think we should fix this, also define this in the specs, most likley best to do this in the execution-apis?
